item.description:
Aki 0.10.1

Changed

  • A session you sent nothing to for five hours (no message, no mark) waits in "+N", even if it keeps running on its own, and comes back as soon as you send it something. One that finished a long job and is asking you something stays in sight. Codex sessions too.
  • Marking opens faster: the screens are known ahead, so it no longer asks the Mac for every window before showing.

Fixed

  • A mark on a localhost page goes to the agent working on it, Codex as much as Claude: the one you picked, then the one that started the page's server, then the one that talked about its address lately, then the one used last.
  • Two servers on one port: the page belongs to the one the browser opens at that address.

item.title: 0.10.1-beta.5
item.description:
Aki 0.10.1 beta

Changed

  • A session you sent nothing to for five hours (no message, no mark) waits in "+N", even if it keeps running on its own, is the destination or has old marks waiting, and comes back as soon as you send it something. Codex sessions too.
  • Marking opens faster: the screens are known ahead, so it no longer asks the Mac for every window before showing.

Fixed

  • A mark on a localhost page goes to the agent working on it, Codex as much as Claude: the one that started the page's server, then the one you picked, then the one that talked about its address lately, then the one used last.
  • Two servers on one port: the page belongs to the one the browser opens.

Aki 0.10.0

New

  • Right-click a limits ring to choose, for that AI alone, what it shows and the line under it: the time left in the 5-hour session ("5H 1h47"), the time until the week renews, or the month on plans with a monthly limit.
  • The limits card shows, below the limits, the week's models and projects and your all-time numbers, as much as fits on the screen.
  • Settings → Usage: each AI's models and projects this week, the days in a row, the busiest day and tokens week by week, counted from the logs on your Mac.
  • Codex: "More from Codex" in Settings → Usage (off until you turn it on) adds your limit resets saved, all-time numbers, longest task and what you call most, asked of OpenAI with the sign-in Codex keeps on your Mac.

Aki 0.9.0

New

  • Sent a mark to the wrong session? In History, "Send to another terminal" sends a copy to the right one and keeps the original where it went, even once it's done.

Fixed

  • A session's card stays open while you move the pointer up to it: the rings and the drag handle on the way no longer close it or swap it for another.
